QuestInfo.name: Corrupted Chow
QuestInfo.1: #p3000018# wants you to bring him a Essence Stone from wherever you visit.
QuestInfo.2: Fetch the stones for #p3000018# once he figures out which one he wants.

0.0: I'm going to eat that old broad the first chance I get.\r\n#L0##bNo you're not dragon-breath. #p3000001#'s my friend. #l\n#k
0.1: By the way, there's something you must do for me once you go to a new world.\r\n#L0##bWhat is it?#l\n#k
0.2: Hey. If you're going to make me jump through another dimension, you gotta do something for me.\r\n#L0##bIt better not be a shorter skirt...#l\n#k
0.3: What? No! Why... why would I... I'm hungry, okay?! I need some Essence Stones \r\n#L0##bYou just made that up.#l\n#k
0.4: I told you about it when we first joined up! It's not my fault you never write anything down. \r\n#L0##bI don't like writing! I can never read my own notes...#l\n#k
0.5: My talons are too fat to hold pencils... but that's neither here nor there! When we get to this new world, you have to feed me any Essence Stones I want, or I'm going to take away your powers AND that amazing outfit!

yes.0: Let me just remind you that this is as good for you as it is for me.
yes.1: So, you wanna make my belly happy and get our first stone? Just talk to me in a minute while I attempt to curb my uncontrollable salivation.

no.0: Why are you so mean to me?! I am your dragon lord!

yes.0: I'll tell you when I feel an Essence Stone nearby. And please don't judge the drooling. It's a genetic problem.
